qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extensive interstate pipeline network, gathering systems, and fractionation plants represent irreplaceable infrastructure with prohibitive replacement costs. However, pricing is constrained by FERC tariff regulation and pipeline competition, resulting in sub-hurdle capital efficiency (10-year median ROIC of 8.5%, never reaching the 12% threshold).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Despite irreplaceable pipeline and fractionation infrastructure, ONEOK operates with high capital intensity and constrained regulatory/contractual pricing power, generating a multi-cycle median ROIC of only ~8.5% (2020-2025 range 6.3%-10.8%). The structural sub-12% capital efficiency fails the Munger hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median ROIC is 8.5% (2020: 6.8%, 2021: 9.8%, 2022: 10.8%, 2023: 9.1%, 2024: ~7.9%, 2025: ~8.1%), failing the 12% Gate 3b hurdle across all cycle points. Recent debt-financed mega-acquisitions (Magellan Midstream for $18.8B in 2023, EnLink and Medallion for $3.3B+ in 2024-2025) expanded total debt to ~$32B against FY25 net income of ~$3.46B (Debt/NI > 9x, Net Debt/EBITDA ~4.6x), diluting returns on capital further.
